title: Wild Garlic and Bouillabaisse Roasted Salmon
description: A flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring wild garlic and bouillabaisse roasted salmon, served with a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: Season the salmon fillets with French sea salt and freshly ground black pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together chopped wild garlic and bouillabaisse.
Place the salmon fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, skin side down.
Brush the wild garlic and bouillabaisse mixture evenly over the salmon fillets.
Drizzle with olive oil and place in the oven.
Roast for 12-15 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
